voievodat.name: The Principality
voievodat.description: Men of the valleys. Strong walls, steady coin, and church bells that unsettle the creatures of the night.
voievodat.legend: Churches: their bells calm the people and weaken any creature that fights nearby. Strong treasury (+25% income).

ai.summary: Keeps their word and defends what is theirs.

zmei.name: The Dragonkin
zmei.description: Dragon-blooded lords of the high peaks. Few in number, terrible in battle, and greedy beyond measure.
zmei.legend: The Hoard: gold breeds gold. Their lords can abduct a rival's heir and demand a ransom.

ai.summary: Picks fights with the weak and can be bought with gold.

iele.name: The Fae Court
iele.description: Wild fairies of the deep woods. Swift and unseen among the trees, their endless dance drives intruders mad.
iele.legend: The Hora: enemies on Fae land are danced to exhaustion each season. In the forests their armies cannot be seen.

ai.summary: Seldom starts a war and is quick to make peace.

strigoi.name: The Revenants
strigoi.description: The restless dead of the marshes. Cheap, countless and slow, and stronger with every grave they open.
strigoi.legend: Raise the dead: after every victory the fallen of both sides rise to join them. They feel no cold and strike harder in winter.

ai.summary: Always hungry for more land; hates the living Principality.

haiduci.name: Outlaws
haiduci.description: Brigands of the forests who rise wherever lords rule badly.
haiduci.legend: They rise wherever public order collapses.
